newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-FAR-BEN downgraded to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-FAR-BEN downgraded to sell.

text.p: Caspian Research said that it has downgraded Mexican pharmaceutical company, Far-Ben S.A., to a sell from a buy rating.

- Caspian also set a new 12-month price target of 20.60 pesos, which represents a nominal peso return of 21.1 percent and a U.S. dollar return of 5.0 percent from current levels (taking into account a year end exchange rate of 9.0 pesos per dollar, it said).

- Analyst Esteban Galindez said the downgrade follows a 37 percent increase in U.S. dollar terms, a deterioration in gross margin that is expected to continue into 1997, and an estimated increase of operating expenses of 13 percent year-over-year in the fourth quarter.
